function.name: get_next_bus
function.description: Get the next bus arrivals at a stop on a Juniper Valley Transit route, and where the bus is right now. Use whenever a caller asks when the next bus comes or says which stop they are waiting at.

stop.description: Stop name or landmark the caller is at or heading to, e.g. "library", "Railyard", "Santa Fe Place Mall"

route.description: Route number as a string: "1" Cerrillos, "2" Hospital Loop, "3" College, "4" Museum Hill
